description: For every input \(x\), \(\chi_R(x)=1\) if and only if \(R(x)\), and \(\chi_R(x)=0\) if and only if \(\neg R(x)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.characteristic_spec.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} (R : α → Prop) (x : α) :
  (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.characteristic R x = 1 ↔ R x) ∧
    (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.characteristic R x = 0 ↔ ¬R x)
